title: Establish repo-local PRD CSV workflow
problem: Loose requirements are hard to track and refine consistently
proposal: Use a git-tracked CSV ledger plus a repo-local Codex skill
acceptance_criteria: PRD CSV exists; PRD README documents the workflow; PRD lint passes
notes: Bootstrap row for the PRD management workflow itself

title: Export active movie library to CSV
problem: Users need a portable spreadsheet of current active library movie metadata
proposal: Add a Settings -> Video storage action that downloads a UTF-8 CSV with code actors title release date and studio
acceptance_criteria: Settings Video storage shows export action; Export downloads CSV with headers 番号 演员 标题 影片发布日期 影片片商; CSV includes all active non-trash movies with effective metadata; Actor cells join names with semicolon; Empty fields stay blank; Export works in Web API and Mock; Failure shows user-visible error

title: Sanitize release configuration
problem: Release artifacts could disclose machine-local paths proxy and provider state
proposal: Stage only the tracked safe example and reject sensitive values
acceptance_criteria: Release never copies local library-config.cfg; Example matches the safe baseline; Release tests reject sensitive examples
notes: Verified locally and included in CI

title: Secure listener and browser-origin defaults
problem: Default network exposure and permissive browser origins could expose a local library
proposal: Use loopback defaults explicit LAN opt-in PIN guard and exact Origin Host checks
acceptance_criteria: Dev and release default to loopback; Non-loopback requires lanEnabled and initialized PIN; Browser origins and hosts are allowlisted
test_refs: cd backend and go test ./...; cd backend and go vet ./...
notes: Verified by backend tests and vet

title: Throttle invalid PIN attempts
problem: Unlimited PIN retries allow local or LAN brute-force attempts
proposal: Apply per-source exponential backoff after repeated failures
acceptance_criteria: Five consecutive failures activate backoff; Response is 429 AUTH_RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After; Success clears counters

title: Manage trusted authentication sessions
problem: Permanent trusted sessions need visibility and revocation without exposing bearer tokens
proposal: Add safe public session IDs and Settings controls for list revoke and revoke-others
acceptance_criteria: Trusted sessions survive restart cleanup; API never returns cookie tokens; Current and other devices are distinguishable; Revocation is confirmed and tested
test_refs: cd backend and go test ./...; pnpm test; pnpm test:e2e
notes: Backend and frontend management are verified

title: Block high production dependency advisories
problem: Known high-severity frontend dependency advisories make releases unsafe
proposal: Upgrade affected dependency chains and enforce production audit
acceptance_criteria: Production audit reports no known vulnerabilities; CI blocks high advisories
test_refs: pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=high; pnpm test; pnpm build
notes: Vite reka-ui picomatch defu postcss and yaml chains patched

title: Enforce SQLite referential integrity
problem: Disabled foreign keys allowed orphaned user-state rows
proposal: Enable and verify foreign keys quarantine historical orphan rows and fail on remaining violations
acceptance_criteria: Every application connection has foreign_keys ON; Historical orphan rows are quarantined before cleanup; foreign_key_check passes after migrations
test_refs: cd backend and go test ./...; cd backend and go vet ./...

title: Start only the active library adapter
problem: Importing the inactive Web adapter triggered backend requests in Mock mode
proposal: Make Web adapter startup explicit and call it only when VITE_USE_WEB_API is true
acceptance_criteria: Mock navigation performs zero backend requests; Web mode still starts the Web adapter exactly once

title: Hydrate protected Web state only after unlock
problem: Locked startup fetched protected progress state and produced avoidable 423 errors
proposal: Wait for authoritative auth status and hydrate once after a successful unlock
acceptance_criteria: Locked startup requests only auth status; Progress and played state hydrate once after unlock; Mock mode does not start the bootstrap

title: Automate frontend backend build audit and runtime gates
problem: Local-only checks allow regressions to reach shared branches
proposal: Add CI jobs for frontend quality backend quality dependency audit builds release tests and Chromium e2e
acceptance_criteria: Workflow exists and validates locally; Pull requests and master pushes run all jobs; Failed e2e uploads diagnostics
implementation_refs: .github/workflows/ci.yml; playwright.e2e.config.ts; tests/e2e/runtime-bootstrap.spec.ts; commits b054cb1e and fc264956
test_refs: pnpm typecheck; pnpm lint; pnpm test; pnpm test:electron; pnpm test:e2e; pnpm build; cd backend and go test ./...; cd backend and go vet ./...
notes: Remote GitHub execution remains pending until an authorized push

title: Make the mobile library touch-safe
problem: Phone controls and movie-card actions were undersized or clipped
proposal: Use stable three-column tabs 44px targets and clipping-safe tag layout
acceptance_criteria: 375px has no page overflow; Primary controls are at least 44 by 44 CSS px; Tag count is not clipped; Route has one semantic h1

title: Enforce frontend bundle budgets
problem: A catch-all vendor chunk forced HLS and search dependencies into startup
proposal: Split expensive media and search dependencies lazily and fail builds that exceed explicit budgets
acceptance_criteria: Initial JS is at most 500k raw and 165k gzip; Total JS is at most 2250k raw and 750k gzip; HLS pinyin and Settings stay outside the initial closure; Build emits a sanitized analysis report
test_refs: pnpm typecheck; pnpm lint; pnpm test; pnpm test:electron; pnpm test:e2e; pnpm build; pnpm build:electron:main
notes: Measured initial JS 448553 raw and 156004 gzip

title: Back up validate and restore a Curated library
problem: Users cannot yet prove that accumulated SQLite and configuration state is recoverable
proposal: Create consistent backup manifests integrity verification restore preflight and explicit restore flow
acceptance_criteria: Backup is transactionally consistent; Manifest identifies schema and files; Verification detects corruption or mismatch; Restore requires preflight and preserves rollback evidence
implementation_refs: backend/internal/backup; backend/internal/maintenance; backend/internal/storage/backup.go; backend/internal/server/backup_handlers.go; backend/cmd/curated/main.go; src/components/jav-library/settings/SettingsBackupSection.vue; commits bd2e9b59 4d0fd1f0 and e7958490
test_refs: cd backend and go test ./...; cd backend and go vet ./...; pnpm typecheck; pnpm lint; pnpm test (167 files 684 tests); pnpm test:electron (4 files 28 tests); pnpm test:e2e (4 Chromium tests); pnpm build; pnpm build:electron:main
notes: Verified backup create validate preflight and offline restore flow; Settings exposes no online restore

title: Migrate stored library paths safely
problem: Drive letters mount points and library roots change over time without a safe bulk migration
proposal: Provide dry-run and apply CLI for path-prefix migration with collision and scope checks
acceptance_criteria: Dry-run reports every affected row and conflict; Apply is transactional; New paths are validated; Unrelated paths remain unchanged
test_refs: cd backend and go test ./...; cd backend and go vet ./...; temporary SQLite CLI plan apply backup-verify audit quick_check and foreign_key_check rehearsal
notes: Verified read-only plan and seven-column whitelist with Windows UNC Unix cross-platform semantics target and conflict blocking automatic verified backup atomic apply plus audit binding reset and rollback evidence

title: Persist resumable upload sessions across restart
problem: Large imports lose in-memory session state when the backend restarts
proposal: Store upload session and chunk state in SQLite and reconcile staging files on startup
acceptance_criteria: Restart preserves valid sessions; Status and commit resume correctly; Expired sessions and orphan staging files are cleaned safely; Source files are never overwritten

title: Expose unified Library Health
problem: Missing files duplicate records broken assets and storage problems lack one actionable view
proposal: Add read-only health scan with categorized findings and safe targeted actions
acceptance_criteria: Health scan reports stable categories and counts; Findings link to affected entities; Destructive actions require confirmation; Scan is safe on offline storage

title: Queue metadata repair by failure category
problem: Users must retry failed or missing metadata one movie at a time
proposal: Aggregate missing and failed metadata and enqueue bounded batch retries by category
acceptance_criteria: Queue supports missing and failed filters; Retry is task-tracked and bounded; Per-item results remain visible; Existing good metadata is not overwritten unexpectedly
notes: Follows the Library Health read-only slice
